findings.description: The policy grants the deployment user unrestricted EC2, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch actions against every matching resource. This enables broad data access and infrastructure modification well beyond least privilege, including S3 data access and actions that can create or alter compute and functions.

The access-key encrypted secret is published as a non-sensitive Terraform output. Although it is encrypted rather than plaintext, Terraform will display and persist this output; possession of the corresponding decryption mechanism can make the credential recoverable, so the output should be marked sensitive and handled as secret material.
